notes: TVA normal rate 10% (CGI art. 187 as amended by the Loi de finances 2015, art. 26, Journal Officiel; the base 2010 code had 7%). Bullion coded 10: the art. 176 exemption list and its exempt-goods annex were read in full - gold and precious metals appear nowhere in the Code. Silver 10/10. Duty null (imports are taxed mainly via the Taxe Intérieure de Consommation; no openable 7108 line).

sources.name: Journal Officiel de Djibouti (journalofficiel.dj) - Loi n° 82/AN/14/7ème L, loi de finances 2015, art. 26
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: CGI art. 187 is amended so the normal VAT rate of 10% applies to all taxable operations
sources.quote: Art.187 a1. 1- Les taux de la TVA sont les suivants : 1) Le taux normal de 10 % est applicable à toutes les opérations taxables.
